title: Zig: Slices
description: Work with slices in Zig — dynamically-sized views into arrays.

steps.title: Slice Basics
steps.description: Declare an array of 5 integers. Create a slice that references elements 1..4 (indices 1, 2, 3). Print the slice elements and its length.
hints: `slice.len` gives the length, iterate with for loop.
